title: Trinity plutonium fallout plume over Roswell
place_text: Trinity site and Roswell, New Mexico

tellings.quote: plume full of plutonium uh that didn't get burned up in the explosion, it just was still there passed over Roswell, so there had a big strip of of uh ur- uranium uh plutonium contaminated soil around Roswell

plain: A scientist, Dr. John Brandenburg, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast, says he was told that after the 1945 Trinity test, the first atomic bomb explosion, in the New Mexico desert, a cloud full of unburned plutonium drifted over the town of Roswell. According to him, this left a large strip of radioactive soil around Roswell. It matters to him because Roswell is where, two years later, many people say a strange craft came down, and he sees a link between the nuclear material and what showed up there.
